content:
Usa Seedance 2.0 Mini dentro del flujo “Brand Film” de Pippit para acelerar la creación de un anuncio: define el producto, añade referencias visuales, construye un moodboard y genera la narrativa visual.  
Genera una versión estilo UGC del mismo producto para un look más auténtico y orientado a redes sociales, adaptando el formato según audiencia y objetivo.  
Para “Narrative Ads”, estructura el video para primero crear curiosidad/emoción/contexto y presentar el producto después, haciendo que el mensaje de marca se sienta más natural.

en.content:
Use Seedance 2.0 Mini within Pippit's "Brand Film" workflow to accelerate the creation of an advertisement: define the product, add visual references, build a moodboard, and generate the visual narrative.  
Create a UGC-style version of the same product for a more authentic, social media-oriented look, adapting the format according to the audience and objective.  
For “Narrative Ads,” structure the video to first create curiosity/emotion/context and present the product afterward, making the brand message feel more natural.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 📦 After seeing the final result, I wanted to understand how quickly the entire creative process could be built.

I used the Brand Film workflow in Pippit:

• Defined the product
• Added visual references
• Built the moodboard
• Generated the visual narrative

The interesting part was not just the quality of the result.

It was the speed of moving from concept to brand content ready for production.

[Thread 2] Not all ads have to look like a Hollywood production.

I also wanted to try an approach much closer to the content we consume every day on social media.

So I generated a UGC-style version for the same product.

✨ More authentic.
✨ More relatable.
✨ Easier to connect with.

The interesting thing is that the same product can adapt to completely different formats depending on the audience and the campaign's objective.

And for many brands, this type of content often creates a much more natural connection with viewers.

[Thread 3] 🎭 Something interesting about Narrative Ads formats is that they capture attention in a different way.

Instead of presenting the product directly, they first generate curiosity, emotion, and context.

And when the story works, the brand message feels much more natural. ✨

📱 Less interruption.
🎬 More narrative.
🎯 More chances to connect with the audience.

That's why I wasn't surprised to see this format become one of the strongest trends in current video marketing.

[Thread 4] 🚀 After trying Brand Film, Creator Style Commerce Videos, and

Narrative Ads, it's clear that the creation of marketing content is evolving rapidly.

What once required teams, high budgets, and long production cycles can now be explored in a much more agile way.

Whether to launch campaigns, test new ideas, or create more brand content, these tools open up very interesting possibilities for marketers and creators.
